datasets.endogenous: HEK293T whole-genome Fiber-seq, reads overlapping DPAGT1 (data/kopah_restore/Hek293_Whole_Genome/target_bams/DPATG1_all_reads.bam)

cell_line_assumption: plasmid transfections assumed HEK293T (to confirm with the user); endogenous data are HEK293T
subsampling: 300-bp constructs: samtools view -s (seed 42) to ~6,000 reads per construct per replicate from the aligned source BAMs (reps 1 and 2); full-length construct and endogenous: all reads

read_filters.plasmid: primary, aligned to the construct contig, spanning the construct end-to-end within 50 bp (full-length linear molecule); treated = m6A/AT >= 0.05 (excludes the untreated component); resolvable = largest fiberhmm footprint < 30% of the read
read_filters.endogenous: primary reads covering the whole 4.1-kb window; same m6A/AT >= 0.05 filter

footprints: fiberhmm-call --enzyme hia5 --seq pacbio --min-mapq 0 (linear mode; reads are linearised NotI or genomic), default model; size classes: TF-size 10-40 bp, PIC-size 41-80 bp, nucleosome >= 85 bp
profiles: per hg38 position: fraction of molecules covered by each size class, and m6A fraction over A/T bases (accessibility), plasmid and endogenous computed separately and shown on the same hg38 axis
motifs: JASPAR 2026 / HOCOMOCO v14 scan of the 300-bp inserts (P < 1e-5) to label candidate TF footprints (e.g. CTCF)

draft10_halfpage._written: 2026-11-05, after the user's draft-9 review, before computing any similarity
draft10_halfpage.reads: replace the random draws with molecules whose chromatin outside the element is alike. Feature per molecule: nucleosome occupancy (calls >= 81 bp) per base over the shown window X0-X1 outside the 300-bp element. Distance: share of those bases where two molecules disagree (Hamming). Reference = the medoid of the 409 footprinted candidates (least mean distance to the other 408). Footprinted reads: the 10 candidates nearest the reference, then, if a footprint bin (20-30 / 31-50 / 51-80 bp inside the element) is missing, the farthest of the 10 is swapped for the nearest candidate carrying that bin (repeated per missing bin). Nucleosome-covered reads: the 3 of the 802 candidates (>= 80% of the element under nucleosome calls) nearest the same reference. Ward ordering within each group as before. Report mean pairwise distance of the shown reads vs the draft-9 reads and vs random sets. This is a display selection (typical flank chromatin), stated in the legend.
